metadata.title: The RAVE Survey: Constraining the Local Galactic Escape Speed

notes: No star meets the eligibility rules. The paper mentions an unidentified group of seven known “hyper-velocity”, probably unbound stars in Section 6.3 (T:p13-b8), but does not provide individual star identifiers or study them as targets. Its analyzed high-velocity RAVE and archival stars are used as bound tracers of the escape speed, and the authors conclude that unbound contaminants in the sample are unlikely (T:p13-b11); no individual sample star is identified or retained as a Galactic unbound candidate.
